newsitem.title: INDONESIA: OLYMPICS-INDONESIA HOPES TO HOST 2008 GAMES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-INDONESIA HOPES TO HOST 2008 GAMES.

text.p: President Suharto said on Friday Indonesia hoped to stage the Asian Games in 2006 and the Olympic Games in 2008, the official Antara news agency reported on Friday.

The agency quoted Minister of Youth and Sports Hayono Isman as saying that Suharto had asked him to "study a possibility that Indonesia becomes the host of Asian Games in 2006 and the Olympics Games in 2008".
Antara gave no further details but said the country's economy should have improved tremendously when both Games take place.
